sealed.name: Prismatic Evolutions Surprise Box
sealed.reason: biggest price gap between the two markets today
sealed.explain: eBay usually runs a little higher on sealed — this is asking 46.2% more, well past that baseline. 125 listings are live right now.

graded.name: Umbreon ex (Prismatic Evolutions)
graded.reason: widest grading payoff on the board today
graded.explain: Ungraded copies trade around $1,491. Perfect-graded (PSA 10) copies have been SELLING near $5,100 — about $3,529 ahead even after the $79.99 grading fee. Based on 550 recorded PSA 10 sales.

raw.name: Umbreon VMAX
raw.reason: the top chase from Evolving Skies — a set moving in today’s numbers
raw.explain: This is the single collectors hunt hardest from Evolving Skies — the card the whole set gets priced around. Market sits at $2,244 today. Its set is 59 months old.
